page.layout: One page of text, full width, with a running head at the top and page number at top right; a short dedicatory verse centred below the text, a printed ornament and the signature "EX" at lower right; a strip of text in the left margin from the neighbouring page (show-through / gutter, not transcribed as main text).

main_text.p: Deum cœlestem Patrem, propter JESUM Christum, Filium ipsius, & Mediatorem nostrum, precor: ut, siquidem non ex eorum es numero, qui Spiritum sanctum blasphemant, adeoq; ad mortem peccant, Te in veritatis viam deducat; tibi errores ac blasphemias propter Christum condonet; teq; nobiscum in æternum beare velit! Amen. Amberga, Prid. Idus Januarii, Anno 1610.
main_text.head: Tui, quantum tu veritatis, studiosus,
LUDOVICUS LUCIUS.

page.notes: The left margin strip shows partial text from the facing page (show-through or gutter); not transcribed. Ornament (printed woodcut fleuron) between the verse and "EX" is not text. Some letters in the first paragraph are faint; "Patrem" and "veritatis" read as printed.
